summary: Verified the streaming description-translation perf fix, streaming correctness, cache behaviour, UI consistency changes and core-flow regressions. The reported 10-20s spinner bug is FIXED: first translated text now arrives in ~0.6-0.9s on the UI (target <3s) and streams progressively via 99+ SSE frames; cached path returns in <0.2s and survives full reload. UI Consistency A passes on mobile (Filters button same row, right of Submodel; hidden on desktop). UI Consistency B PARTIALLY FAILS — border-radius (10px), border-width (1px) and border-color match across all 5 elements, but the required non-none box-shadow is MISSING on all five (make/model/submodel selects, mobile filters button, #sort-control) AND on car-card / car-row, because Tailwind's arbitrary-value class `shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)]` is being emitted with an empty `box-shadow` property (only `--tw-shadow-colored` is set). Core regressions PASS: list/detail prices match on 3 cars (15199, 15799, 20799 EUR), FX haircut pytest 5/5 green, lightbox opens, /saved loads, /admin shows all 3 tabs.

ui_bugs.component: TaxonomySelects, SortControl, SearchPage Filters button (and by extension car-card/car-row)
ui_bugs.issue: Tailwind arbitrary class `shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)]` produces a CSS rule with empty `box-shadow` (only sets `--tw-shadow-colored: var(--tw-shadow-colored)`), so the computed `boxShadow` on all five taxonomy/sort/filters controls resolves to `none`. Same for `shadow-[var(--shadow-md)]`. The `--shadow-sm` CSS var IS defined (`0 1px 2px rgba(17,20,26,0.07)`). Fix: replace `shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)]` with either the built-in `shadow-sm` utility or a literal arbitrary value like `shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(17,20,26,0.07)]` (the literal form is already known to work in this stylesheet, e.g. `.shadow-\[0_1px_2px_rgba\(18\,20\,23\,0\.06\)\]`).

action_items: Replace `shadow-[var(--shadow-sm)]` (and `shadow-[var(--shadow-md)]`) usages with either Tailwind's built-in `shadow-sm`/`shadow-md` or a LITERAL arbitrary value like `shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(17,20,26,0.07)]`. Files: /app/frontend/src/components/TaxonomySelects.js, /app/frontend/src/components/SortControl.js, /app/frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.js (open-filters-button), and the CarCard/CarRow components (to make card shadow non-none as required by UI Consistency B).

Optional: total-completion time for streamed translation is 21-23s on ~3200-char outputs. That's fine progressively (first text at ~0.7s) but if you want the completion number closer to the claimed 4.87s, consider chunk-cap or async prefetch. Not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: SSE endpoint sets `X-Accel-Buffering: no` — good; observed 99+ frames, proving proxy isn't buffering.
Frontend SSE parser correctly handles chunk boundaries — no duplicated fragments or leaked `data:`/JSON braces in any test.
The permanent translation cache correctly survives full page reloads (post-reload retranslate = 0.13s).
Two Radix warnings in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' when opening the filter sheet — accessibility polish only, non-blocking.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the missing box-shadow: Tailwind CSS parses `shadow-[<value>]` in two ways. For a raw color-like or full-shadow literal, it emits a proper rule `box-shadow: var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow,...), var(--tw-ring-shadow,...), var(--tw-shadow);` plus `--tw-shadow: <value>`. But when the arbitrary value is `var(--shadow-sm)`, Tailwind's parser treats it as a 'colored shadow' and emits ONLY `--tw-shadow-colored: var(--tw-shadow-colored);` with an EMPTY `box-shadow` declaration — so nothing paints. Confirmed by inspecting `document.styleSheets`: rule `.shadow-\[var\(--shadow-sm\)\]` has `box: ''` and `--tw-shadow: var(--tw-shadow-colored)`, whereas `.shadow-sm` and the literal `.shadow-\[0_1px_2px_rgba\(18\,20\,23\,0\.06\)\]` have `box: 'var(--tw-ring-offset-shadow,...),...,var(--tw-shadow)'`. Mitigation: use `shadow-sm` or a literal `shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(17,20,26,0.07)]`.
